title: The quasi-coherent sheaf of a module on Spec and its sections over principal opens
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $N$ an $R$-module. There is a sheaf of $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R}$-modules $\widetilde N$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with $R$-linear maps $\tau_U:N\to\widetilde N(U)$ for all opens $U$, compatible with restriction ($\tau_U(n)|_V=\tau_V(n)$), such that for every $r\in R$ the map $\tau_{D(r)}:N\to\widetilde N(D(r))$ is a localization of $N$ at the powers of $r$, i.e. induces an isomorphism $N_r\cong\widetilde N(D(r))$, $n/r^k\mapsto r^{-k}\tau_{D(r)}(n)$; under these isomorphisms the restriction $\widetilde N(D(r))\to\widetilde N(D(rr'))$ is the canonical map $N_r\to N_{rr'}$ and the $\mathcal O(D(r))=R_r$-module structure is the natural one. Moreover $\widetilde N$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent].
